messages.subject: bloom online orders
messages.body:
Hi Meera,

Bloom has 4.7 stars from 320 reviews but orders still come in by phone. I run a small web studio that has delivered sites for 15+ paying clients, including a clothing store that takes Razorpay payments.

Want me to send a one-page mock-up of an order page for Bloom?

If you would rather not hear from me, reply "no thanks" and I will not write again.
